The new Step7c source writer describes the BacDive production values for `2,5-didehydro-D-gluconate` as blank, but both saved primary pages explicitly encode **No** in the result icon's `alt` and `title` attributes. Text-only HTML extraction loses those attributes.

The captured pages for strains34 and58 each contain the CHEBI:11449 row followed by `<i class="ph ph-x text-danger" alt="No" title="No">`. Neighboring mono-keto rows encode Yes. This changes the interpretation of the evidence, although the independently counted two source-field appearances and the decision not to infer positive production remain correct.

Affected writer: `scripts/curate_step7c_source_labels.py`, frozen SHA245c02dac2fb1b2101d14eb261ab16a186bf3d2d3980e8f8d56adda178e82e67. The false sentence is copied into the new owner's mapping evidence and creation history.

Correct current provenance through the guarded workflow, retaining executed source receipts, original captures and history. Add a regression covering No, Yes and genuinely absent result information. Preserve the di-keto count2, mono-keto count288, identities and scientific holds; add no production role or scientific approval.

Primary pages: [BacDive34](https://bacdive.dsmz.de/strain/34), [BacDive58](https://bacdive.dsmz.de/strain/58). Both table headers are `@ref Chebi-ID Metabolite Production`. The saved complete captures are already in `reports/step7c_source_labels_313_235_20261102/sources/bacdive-{34,58}.html`.

The relevant regression currently asserts that the new owner note contains `blank`; it therefore codifies this evidence error. Preserve that executed version as historical evidence while adding coverage for the corrected active interpretation.

Independent evidence receipt SHA256: `20aab65e48aa06ef9767364fa5c101d0bde273e5ade3e085ab27afdac67735fb`. This is an in-scope review finding for #313; it does not change the source-count or substance-identity decision.
